## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Bug fix: a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] User-facing change: changeset (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] New or changed option/behaviour: card README, docs site (`apps/web`) and UI editor updated
- [ ] Visual change: `pnpm test:visual` run, baselines updated only for intended changes
